passport.label: Passport
passport.desc: A valid passport showing the holder’s identity and nationality, with sufficient validity and blank pages.

passport_photo.label: Passport Photo
passport_photo.desc: A recent passport-sized photograph meeting official photo specifications.

application_form.label: Application Form
application_form.desc: The completed and signed visa application form required by the issuing authority.

proof_of_funds.label: Proof Of Funds
proof_of_funds.desc: Evidence showing sufficient financial means to support the stay, such as bank statements.

travel_itinerary.label: Travel Itinerary
travel_itinerary.desc: Details of planned travel, including flight bookings and accommodation arrangements.

return_ticket.label: Return Ticket
return_ticket.desc: Proof of onward or return travel demonstrating intent to leave the country after the visit.

fee_receipt.label: Fee Receipt
fee_receipt.desc: Proof of payment for the visa application or related processing fees.

medical_cover.label: Medical Cover
medical_cover.desc: Evidence of medical insurance or health cover valid for the duration of the stay.

police_clearance_certificate.label: Police Clearance Certificate
police_clearance_certificate.desc: An official certificate confirming the applicant’s criminal record status.

birth_certificate.label: Birth Certificate
birth_certificate.desc: An official record confirming the applicant’s birth details and parentage.

marriage_certificate.label: Marriage Certificate
marriage_certificate.desc: An official document proving a legally recognized marriage.

employment_contract.label: Employment Contract
employment_contract.desc: A signed agreement outlining employment terms with an employer in the destination country.

employer_undertaking.label: Employer Undertaking
employer_undertaking.desc: A formal letter from the employer confirming employment responsibilities and conditions.

labour_certificate.label: Labour Certificate
labour_certificate.desc: An official authorization confirming compliance with labor or employment regulations.

curriculum_vitae.label: Curriculum Vitae
curriculum_vitae.desc: A detailed summary of the applicant’s education, skills, and work experience.

experience_letters.label: Experience Letters
experience_letters.desc: Letters from previous employers confirming the applicant’s work history and roles.

qualification_certificates.label: Qualification Certificates
qualification_certificates.desc: Certificates or diplomas proving educational or professional qualifications.

saqa_evaluation.label: Saqa Evaluation
saqa_evaluation.desc: An evaluation confirming the equivalence of foreign qualifications to local standards.

saica_letter.label: Saica Letter
saica_letter.desc: A professional letter confirming recognition or membership with the relevant accounting body.

business_plan.label: Business Plan
business_plan.desc: A detailed plan outlining the proposed business activities, objectives, and financial projections.

proof_investment.label: Proof Investment
proof_investment.desc: Evidence showing that the required investment funds have been committed or transferred.

capital_proof.label: Capital Proof
capital_proof.desc: Documentation confirming access to sufficient capital for business or investment purposes.

company_registration.label: Company Registration
company_registration.desc: Official documents confirming the legal registration of a company.

shareholder_certificates.label: Shareholder Certificates
shareholder_certificates.desc: Documents proving ownership or shareholding in a registered company.

tax_clearance.label: Tax Clearance
tax_clearance.desc: An official certificate confirming that tax obligations are up to date.

bbbee_certificate.label: Bbbee Certificate
bbbee_certificate.desc: Certification confirming compliance with Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment requirements.

staff_undertaking.label: Staff Undertaking
staff_undertaking.desc: A declaration confirming commitments related to staff employment or training.

radiological_report.label: Radiological Report
radiological_report.desc: A medical imaging report, often required to screen for specific health conditions.

yellow_fever_certificate.label: Yellow Fever Certificate
yellow_fever_certificate.desc: Proof of yellow fever vaccination when required for travel from certain regions.

repatriation_guarantee.label: Repatriation Guarantee
repatriation_guarantee.desc: A guarantee covering the cost of returning the applicant to their home country if required.

program_confirmation.label: Program Confirmation
program_confirmation.desc: Official confirmation of enrollment in an approved study, exchange, or training program.

dti_recommendation.label: Dti Recommendation
dti_recommendation.desc: A recommendation letter from the relevant trade or industry authority supporting the application.

waiver_letter.label: Waiver Letter
waiver_letter.desc: A formal request or approval to waive specific visa requirements.

medical_report.label: Medical Report
medical_report.desc: A general medical assessment confirming the applicant’s health status.

motivation_letter.label: Motivation Letter
motivation_letter.desc: A personal letter explaining the purpose of travel and reasons for applying.

other_supporting_documents.label: Other Supporting Documents
other_supporting_documents.desc: Any additional documents required to support or clarify the visa application.
